verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents generating API credentials under Settings > Access Management > API Credentials, with configurable permissions and an optional expiry date. Endpoints also reference named permissions such as "View roles in account" and "Monitor and unmonitor customers", which shows a permission model that scoped credentials can use. The depth of least-privilege scoping is thin in the evidence, and nothing addresses agent-specific credentials. missing for 10: a documented full catalog of per-credential permission scopes and how granular they are, agent- or service-account-specific credential guidance, documentation of revocation and rotation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: These can be generated in the ComplyAdvantage Mesh web application under Settings > Access Management > API Credentials, where you can also configure their permissions and optional expiry date.
You need the "View roles in account" permission to use this endpoint.
